heading: INT. BRIDAL SUITE, MOUNTAIN CHALET - MORNING

units.text: INT. BRIDAL SUITE, MOUNTAIN CHALET - MORNING
Chintz and antlers.
A garment bag hangs on a door.
Six women crowd a mirror, a hairdryer roars, and someone's phone plays a wedding march at the wrong speed.
THE BRIDE (30s, in a half-pinned dress, a veil crushed on one arm, her face fixed in perfect, polite panic) stands on a footstool.

Around her, in a frieze of competence: AUNT FLORENTINA OSEI-VANCE (60s, pearls) with a threaded needle; COUSIN PRUDENCE LINDQVIST (20s, flower crown) with a glue gun; SISTER ODALYS BARTHOLOMEW (30s, matron of honor) with a clipboard; MAKEUP ARTIST JIN-HO KOWALCZYK (30s, brushes in a tool belt) with a compact; and DENISE (40s, planner, earpiece, headset) with a radio.
Everyone is speaking at once, but no one is hearing anyone.
Bride is in the dress. I repeat, in the dress.
units.name: DENISE

units.text: Hold still, dear, there's a gap.
units.name: AUNT FLORENTINA

units.text: Is that glitter supposed to be on the bodice?
units.name: COUSIN PRUDENCE

units.text: It's not glitter, it's a thread.
units.name: ODALYS

units.text: It's glitter.
units.name: JIN-HO

units.text: The Bride says nothing.
A single tear tracks through her foundation.

Jin-Ho dabs it with a sponge before it drops; Aunt Florentina stitches; Prudence mends the flower crown with the glue gun; Odalys crosses something off the clipboard; and Denise paces to the window with the radio, listening to a voice no one else can hear.
Repeat? The groom has what?
units.name: DENISE

units.text: A pause.
Denise turns, slowly.
The room goes silent.
The hairdryer winds down.
Everything's fine. Nothing to worry about.
units.name: DENISE

units.text: Denise.
units.name: ODALYS

units.text: It's fine.
units.name: DENISE

units.text: What did he say?
units.name: ODALYS

units.text: The groom would like a word.
units.name: DENISE

units.text: The Bride steps off the footstool, one satin shoe at a time, and walks to the door.
Aunt Florentina's needle follows her until the thread snaps.
At the threshold, she stops.
Takes the veil from her arm.
Hands it to Denise.
Hold this.
units.name: THE BRIDE

units.text: She goes out.
The door closes.
Prudence lifts the glue gun, sets it down.
Five women look at the closed door.
One by one, they take out their phones.
I knew it.
units.name: JIN-HO
